purpose: AE Black Mamba GBNF grammar alignment artifact — soft constraint during full-FT training; targets strategy §6 ≥90% unconstrained AgentTurn validity post-training.

hyperparameters.lambda_rationale: Soft penalty weight in L_total = L_ce + λ·L_grammar. 0.1 starts the model leaning toward the grammar manifold without overwhelming the next-token cross-entropy signal from the AgentTurn JSON content. Sweep [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.3] if convergence is slow.
hyperparameters.penalty_form: For each training position p, let M_p = grammar-legal-token-id set at that state. L_grammar(p) = sum_{t in vocab\M_p} softmax(logits_p)[t]. Mean over positions, weighted by sequence length.

alignment_target.metric: unconstrained-eval AgentTurn schema-validity rate on held-out prompt set
alignment_target.gap_interpretation: A small gap means the model internalized the grammar; a large gap means the grammar mask is overriding the model at inference.

moms_law: Every state, every token mapping, every rejected corpus row itemized. No padding. No silent grammar relaxation. Receipts only.
